<script>
wbq.push(function manageSearchScreen() {
  const search = document.getElementsByClassName('js__search-screen')[0];
  const searchCloseBtn = document.getElementById('search-screen-close-btn');
  const mastheadSearchOpenBtn = document.getElementById('masthead-search-open-btn');
  const nav = document.getElementsByClassName('js__nav')[0];

  function lockSearchFocus() {
    searchCloseBtn.focus();
    document.addEventListener('focusin', focusSearchCloseBtn);
  }

  function focusSearchCloseBtn(event) {
    if (!event.target.closest('#search-screen')) {
      searchCloseBtn.focus();
    }
  }

  function unlockSearchFocus() {
    document.removeEventListener('focusin', focusSearchCloseBtn);
    mastheadSearchOpenBtn.focus();
  }

  const toggleSearchScreen = (event) => {
    // Toggle search screen visibility
    search.classList.toggle('search-screen--is-open');

    if (search.classList.contains('search-screen--is-open')) {
      if (window.DEVICE_VIEW === 'desktop') {
        lockSearchFocus();
      }
      window.TMZ.utils.setAccessibilityFocusTrap('search-screen');
      search.style.visibility = 'visible';
      setTimeout(function() {
        nav.style.visibility = 'hidden';
      }, 300);
    } else {
      window.TMZ.utils.removeAccessibilityFocusTrap();
      if (window.DEVICE_VIEW === 'desktop') {
        unlockSearchFocus();
        mastheadSearchOpenBtn.focus();
      }
      setTimeout(function() {
        search.style.visibility = 'hidden';
      }, 300);
    }

    // Hide nav
    if (nav.classList.contains('nav--is-open')) {
      setTimeout(function () {
        nav.classList.remove('nav--is-open');
      }, 300);
    }
    event.preventDefault();
  };

  // close X used to dismiss mobile search overlay
  document.querySelectorAll('.js__btn--search-toggle').forEach(searchBtn => {
    searchBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleSearchScreen);
  });
});
</script>

Meghan Markle Shares Rare Family Video of Harry, Kids Enjoying UK Life

By TMZ Staff
Published September 13, 2026 8:18 AM PDT
BRITISH BEGINNINGS
Video: Meghan Markle Shares Glimpse of Prince Harry and Kids' New Life in UK

Meghan Markle is giving fans a rare peek at life with Prince Harry and their kids after the family's move back to the UK -- and the video is about as low-key as it gets.

Meghan posted a video Sunday packed with candid family moments, including shots of Harry spending time outdoors with Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet.

Lilibet is seen riding her bike down a country path while Archie runs alongside her, while another clip shows Archie splashing through a puddle in rain boots.

Prince Harry & Meghan Markle Blasted by 'SNL UK' Over Move Back to Britain

By TMZ Staff
Published September 13, 2026 5:20 AM PDT | Updated September 13, 2026 6:59 AM PDT
Getty

Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are getting mocked across the pond after making their highly publicized return to the United Kingdom.

The Duke and Duchess of Sussex were spoofed during the Season 2 premiere of "Saturday Night Live UK," with actors Jack Shep and Ayoade Bamgboye playing the couple in a sketch set at Balmoral Castle.

In the bit, Harry greets his father, King Charles, by saying, “Daddy, I’m home” -- prompting Charles to joke that the couple had already blown through their reported $60 million Netflix deal.

Steve McBee Sr. Home After Prison Release ... Reunites With Family

By TMZ Staff
Published September 13, 2026 7:24 AM PDT

Steve McBee Sr. is back home and back with his family after spending months behind bars ... and the 'McBee Dynasty' patriarch is making it clear he’s appreciating the little things.

Steve shared his first public message following his release Saturday, posting a video from his return to the family farm in Gallatin, Missouri. The reality star expressed gratitude for being home and for the blessings in his life.

His return has been an emotional one for the McBee family. Steve’s son, Steven McBee Jr., celebrated his dad’s release online, while another son, Cole McBee, shared a photo of Steve meeting his newest granddaughter, Tate, who was born while he was incarcerated.

Brian Hickerson had a wild night with his brother, Zach, at a South Carolina bar ... and it ended with the brothers in handcuffs and Brian claiming that police leaked details about the death of his actress girlfriend, Hayden Panettiere.

The Greenville PD tells TMZ ... Brian was ultimately released, but Zach was taken into custody for disorderly conduct and brought to jail.

TMZ.com

All the drama kicked off Saturday night at Wild Wing Cafe in Greenville when Brian suddenly picked up a stool at the bar and slung it backwards, according to sources with direct knowledge.

By TMZ Staff
Published September 13, 2026 1:00 AM PDT
Getty

Pretty Ricky member Spectacular Smith is being sued by an Arizona woman who claims he messaged her on Instagram to meet up before sexually assaulting her.

According to a new lawsuit obtained TMZ, a woman named Alexis Dieng filed a complaint against the rapper in August, alleging he contacted her in October of last year requesting recommendations for restaurants. Dieng claims Smith then cultivated her trust and arranged to meet her in person.

According to the suit, Smith provided Dieng with an initial meeting location but then changed the meet-up place to a residence in Maricopa County ... where she says she eventually arrived by herself around 10:30 PM the next day.

Dieng claims Smith initiated physical contact with her and then engaged in sexual intercourse with her without her consent.

Backgrid

Waiting for your permission to load the Instagram Media.

By TMZ Staff
Published September 12, 2026 3:45 PM PDT | Updated September 12, 2026 4:23 PM PDT

Comedian Charleston White has been arrested for battery in Florida ... TMZ has learned.

Getty

White was then booked into Broward County jail on a Touch Or Strike/Battery charge, which is a misdemeanor ... arrest records show.

Check out these pics of the star from a New York Fashion Week event Friday night ... where she wore a button-down shirt -- then popped the buttons to let her tanned tummy breathe.

We've learned Lexy is 5 months pregnant ... after marrying her mystery fiancé back in February -- another bombshell revelation. She's still keeping his ID a secret ... apparently he's a super low-key dude.

Sydney Sweeney BF Scooter Dips Her in Front of Palace For Bday ... I Love You, Syd!!!

By TMZ Staff
Published September 12, 2026 12:11 PM PDT
Swaying With Sydney
Video: Scooter Braun Shares Cute Video Celebrating Sydney Sweeney's Birthday

Scooter Braun is dancing with, dipping, and makin' out with Sydney Sweeney in his PDA-filled birthday post dedicated to his girlfriend's big day ... and his note to her is even sweeter.

Filming in front of what appears to be Avignon's Palace of the Popes in the South of France ... the music mogul and "Euphoria" actress -- who turns 29 today -- danced to Mitski's "My Love Mine All Mine" in his Instagram post that he uploaded Saturday.

Scooter wrote in the caption ... "You make me smile harder, laugh louder, adventure more, and dream bigger. You’ve made the ordinary feel exciting and the future feel like something I can’t wait to get to."

Adding that her "giggle can change an entire day" ... Scooter admitted he loves "how corny we can be together, because nothing else matters. There are a million things I could say, but the ones that matter most are just for you." And yes, he even used the L-word!!! 👀

Launch Gallery
Sydney Sweeney's Hot Shots Launch Gallery

His sweet birthday message comes as the couple seemingly have gotten even more serious ... as we reported, Sydney has been spending more time with Scooter's kids in recent weeks.

The two also jetted off to Venice to flaunt their amore last week ... taking a boat ride down the canal together.

Happy birthday, Syd! We hope it's a euphoric one.

  • Exclusive
By TMZ Staff
Published September 12, 2026 8:15 AM PDT
OFF THE STREETS
Video: Daisy De La Hoya Says Corey Feldman Saved Her Life During Addiction Battle
TMZ.com

Daisy De La Hoya says Corey Feldman saved her life when her addiction spiraled ... as she now tries to rebuild after revealing she was homeless and is struggling to find work.

We caught up with the "Rock of Love" alum in Los Angeles Friday ... and she says Corey, her best friend of nearly 18 years, picked her up in Las Vegas, collected her belongings and took in her dog.

Daisy says Corey helped get her back to California ... where she entered recovery. She says she’s been clean since February 29, 2024.

By TMZ Staff
Published September 12, 2026 6:35 AM PDT
Getty

Nick Reiner won't be blowing out any birthday candles behind bars ... as authorities say he'll be treated just like every other inmate ... meaning no perks -- and no presents.

Nick -- who is accused of brutally murdering filmmaker father Rob Reiner and producer mother, Michele Singer Reiner -- will have no extra privileges Monday, which is when the accused killer turns 33.

FIGHTING THE CHARGES
Video: Nick Reiner Pleads Not Guilty To Murdering His Parents | TMZ Live
TMZ.com

"Birthdays are treated like every other day, no special treatment from LASD," a Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department representative told Page Six.

By TMZ Staff
Published September 12, 2026 1:00 AM PDT | Updated September 12, 2026 4:48 AM PDT

Steve Burton claims his ex-wife, Sheree Gustin, is playing games over custody of their daughter Brooklyn … and says she slammed his new wife in front of their daughter ... TMZ has learned.

In court docs obtained by TMZ, Steve says Sheree told Brooklyn that his new wife and stepdaughters are "not family," deleted messages from the stepsisters, and has "told Brooklyn that Steve and his wife are 'brainwashing' her, conduct that has caused Brooklyn to whisper during calls and delete her own messages out of fear of her mother's reaction."

Getty

Steve claims Sheree’s "affair and pregnancy outside the marriage" was the cause of their divorce … but says Sheree nevertheless still continues to hold significant anger toward his new wife.

Lady Gaga & Michael Polansky Our Star Was Born!!!

By TMZ Staff
Published September 11, 2026 5:33 PM PDT | Updated September 12, 2026 4:48 AM PDT
Getty

Lady Gaga and Michael Polansky have a new little "Monster" in their lives ... welcoming their first child!!!

The couple has recently become parents for the first time, according to Page Six. No further information has been released regarding the newborn ... including the child’s name, gender, or exact date of birth.

Getty

Gaga dropped a massive hint about having kids with Polansky a few months ago ... calling motherhood her "next starring role" on "The Late Show with Stephen Colbert" back in November. She made similar statements in interviews at that time with other outlets.

<script>
wbq.push(function manageHamburgerMenu(app) {
  const nav = document.getElementsByClassName('js__nav')[0];
  const navCloseBtn = document.getElementById('nav-close-btn');
  const navToggleBtn = document.getElementsByClassName('js__btn--nav-toggle');

  function lockNavFocus() {
    navCloseBtn.focus();
    document.addEventListener('focusin', focusNavCloseBtn);
  }

  function focusNavCloseBtn(event) {
    if (!event.target.closest('#masthead-nav')) {
      navCloseBtn.focus();
    }
  }

  function unlockNavFocus() {
    document.removeEventListener('focusin', focusNavCloseBtn);
    navToggleBtn[0].focus();
  }

  // hamburger menu to toggle mobile nav, full screen hit area beneath
  // mobile nav to act as toggle target
  function hamburgerMenuHandler(event) {
    nav.classList.toggle('nav--is-open');
    if (nav.classList.contains('nav--is-open')) {
      if (DEVICE_VIEW === 'desktop') {
        lockNavFocus();
      }

      app.utils.setAccessibilityFocusTrap('masthead-nav');
      nav.style.visibility = 'visible';
      if (DEVICE_VIEW !== 'desktop') {
         document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      }

    } else {
      app.utils.removeAccessibilityFocusTrap();
      if (DEVICE_VIEW === 'desktop') {
        unlockNavFocus();
        navToggleBtn[0].focus();
      }
      setTimeout(function () {
        nav.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        if (DEVICE_VIEW !== 'desktop') {
           document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
      }, 300);
    }

    event.preventDefault();
  }

  Array.from(navToggleBtn).forEach(navBtn => navBtn.addEventListener('click', hamburgerMenuHandler));
});
</script>

wbq.push(function manageTipMenu() {
  const tip = document.getElementsByClassName('js__tip')[0];
  const body = document.getElementsByTagName('body')[0];
  const tipCloseBtn = document.getElementById('tip__btn-close');
  const tipToggleBtn = document.getElementsByClassName('js__btn--tip-toggle');
  const nav = document.getElementsByClassName('js__nav')[0];

  function lockTipFocus() {
    tipCloseBtn.focus();
    document.addEventListener('focusin', focusTipCloseBtn);
  }

  function focusTipCloseBtn(event) {
    if (!event.target.closest('#tip')) {
      tipCloseBtn.focus();
    }
  }

  function unlockTipFocus() {
    document.removeEventListener('focusin', focusTipCloseBtn);
  }

  // toggle tip full screen mobile menu
  function toggleTipMenu(event) {

    tip.classList.toggle('tip--is-open');
    if (tip.classList.contains('tip--is-open')) {
      if (DEVICE_VIEW === 'desktop') {
        lockTipFocus();
      }
      window.TMZ.utils.setAccessibilityFocusTrap('tip');
      tip.style.visibility = 'visible';
      if (DEVICE_VIEW !== 'desktop') {
        body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      }
      setTimeout(function() {
        nav.style.visibility = 'hidden';
      }, 300);

    } else {
      window.TMZ.utils.removeAccessibilityFocusTrap();
      if (DEVICE_VIEW === 'desktop') {
        unlockTipFocus();
        tipToggleBtn[0].focus();
      }
      setTimeout(function() {
        tip.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        if (DEVICE_VIEW !== 'desktop') {
          body.style.overflow = '';
        }
      }, 300);
    }

    // Hide nav
    if (nav.classList.contains('nav--is-open')) {
      setTimeout(function () {
        nav.classList.remove('nav--is-open');
      }, 300);
    }
    event.preventDefault();
  }

  Array.from(tipToggleBtn).forEach(tipBtn => tipBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleTipMenu));
});
</script>

Newsweek named TMZ the \u201cBreakout Blog of 2007.\u201d<\/p>"},{"_schema":"pbj:tmz:canvas:block:heading-block:1-0-0","etag":"4edb26f13ca8954cb43de05dc0fff614","aside":false,"text":"Leadership","size":4},{"_schema":"pbj:tmz:canvas:block:divider-block:1-0-0","etag":"585ea8aac550a08a3096bd75df9b22fd","aside":false,"stroke_color":"primary","stroke_style":"solid"},{"_schema":"pbj:tmz:canvas:block:text-block:1-0-0","etag":"7dd5073d8b549b5b4ada0c26cecab9f2","aside":false,"text":"<ul><li><strong>Harvey Levin<\/strong>, <em>Executive Producer<\/em><br>Harvey founded TMZ in 2005 and has been the Executive Producer of TMZ.com ever since.  Harvey has been a lawyer, a law professor, a radio personality, a columnist for the L.A. Times and an investigative reporter for the NBC and CBS affiliates in Los Angeles.  He has won nine Emmy awards, and has received numerous other journalism awards.<\/li><li><strong>Charles Latibeaudiere<\/strong>, <em>Executive Producer<\/em><br>Charles is Executive Producer and Managing Editor of TMZ and TMZ.com.  He\u2019s been with the company since the 2007 launch of TMZ on TV. Deven holds a BA in Journalism from the School of Journalism and Mass Communications at San Jose State University.<\/li><li><a href=\"mailto:Lucas.widman@tmz.com\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">Lucas Widman<\/a><br>Lucas is a Senior News Producer for TMZ Sports from Sandusky, Ohio. <script>
wbq.push(function manageHamburgerMenu(app) {
  const nav = document.getElementsByClassName('js__nav')[0];
  const navCloseBtn = document.getElementById('nav-close-btn');
  const navToggleBtn = document.getElementsByClassName('js__btn--nav-toggle');

  function lockNavFocus() {
    navCloseBtn.focus();
    document.addEventListener('focusin', focusNavCloseBtn);
  }

  function focusNavCloseBtn(event) {
    if (!event.target.closest('#masthead-nav')) {
      navCloseBtn.focus();
    }
  }

  function unlockNavFocus() {
    document.removeEventListener('focusin', focusNavCloseBtn);
    navToggleBtn[0].focus();
  }

  // hamburger menu to toggle mobile nav, full screen hit area beneath
  // mobile nav to act as toggle target
  function hamburgerMenuHandler(event) {
    nav.classList.toggle('nav--is-open');
    if (nav.classList.contains('nav--is-open')) {
      if (DEVICE_VIEW === 'desktop') {
        lockNavFocus();
      }

      app.utils.setAccessibilityFocusTrap('masthead-nav');
      nav.style.visibility = 'visible';
      if (DEVICE_VIEW !== 'desktop') {
         document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      }

    } else {
      app.utils.removeAccessibilityFocusTrap();
      if (DEVICE_VIEW === 'desktop') {
        unlockNavFocus();
        navToggleBtn[0].focus();
      }
      setTimeout(function () {
        nav.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        if (DEVICE_VIEW !== 'desktop') {
           document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
      }, 300);
    }

    event.preventDefault();
  }

  Array.from(navToggleBtn).forEach(navBtn => navBtn.addEventListener('click', hamburgerMenuHandler));
});
</script>

<script>
wbq.push(function manageTipMenu() {
  const tip = document.getElementsByClassName('js__tip')[0];
  const body = document.getElementsByTagName('body')[0];
  const tipCloseBtn = document.getElementById('tip__btn-close');
  const tipToggleBtn = document.getElementsByClassName('js__btn--tip-toggle');
  const nav = document.getElementsByClassName('js__nav')[0];

  function lockTipFocus() {
    tipCloseBtn.focus();
    document.addEventListener('focusin', focusTipCloseBtn);
  }

  function focusTipCloseBtn(event) {
    if (!event.target.closest('#tip')) {
      tipCloseBtn.focus();
    }
  }

  function unlockTipFocus() {
    document.removeEventListener('focusin', focusTipCloseBtn);
  }

  // toggle tip full screen mobile menu
  function toggleTipMenu(event) {

    tip.classList.toggle('tip--is-open');
    if (tip.classList.contains('tip--is-open')) {
      if (DEVICE_VIEW === 'desktop') {
        lockTipFocus();
      }
      window.TMZ.utils.setAccessibilityFocusTrap('tip');
      tip.style.visibility = 'visible';
      if (DEVICE_VIEW !== 'desktop') {
        body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      }
      setTimeout(function() {
        nav.style.visibility = 'hidden';
      }, 300);

    } else {
      window.TMZ.utils.removeAccessibilityFocusTrap();
      if (DEVICE_VIEW === 'desktop') {
        unlockTipFocus();
        tipToggleBtn[0].focus();
      }
      setTimeout(function() {
        tip.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        if (DEVICE_VIEW !== 'desktop') {
          body.style.overflow = '';
        }
      }, 300);
    }

    // Hide nav
    if (nav.classList.contains('nav--is-open')) {
      setTimeout(function () {
        nav.classList.remove('nav--is-open');
      }, 300);
    }
    event.preventDefault();
  }

  Array.from(tipToggleBtn).forEach(tipBtn => tipBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleTipMenu));
});

            <p>The term “Thirty Mile Zone” originated in the 1960s, when due to the  growth of location shoots, studios established a “thirty mile zone” to  monitor rules for filming in Hollywood. The center of the zone was the  offices of The Association of Motion Pictures and Television Producers,  formerly at Beverly and La Cienega Boulevards in Los Angeles. TMZ  reinvented the thirty mile zone and now serves as the Internet’s  premiere address for entertainment news.</p>

    data-context="{"section":"permalink","name":"text_block"}"    >
            <p>Launched in 2005, TMZ’s  meteoric rise followed its exclusive on two of the biggest stories in  entertainment: Mel Gibson's DUI arrest and subsequent encounter with law  enforcement, and Michael Richards' ill-fated trip to the Laugh Factory.  TMZ also broke the news of the breakup of Britney Spears and Kevin  Federline's marriage.</p>
      </section><!--/#cb-ed212cbb769dec2d3f11bdfa5f59fac8-->

    <section

    data-context="{"section":"permalink","name":"text_block"}"    >
            <p>TMZ altered the entertainment news  landscape by changing the way the public gets its news. Frequently  referenced by various media, TMZ is one of the most-cited entertainment  news sources, utilized by national network and local newsgathering  organizations across the country.</p>

<script>
wbq.push(function manageSearchScreen() {
  const search = document.getElementsByClassName('js__search-screen')[0];
  const searchCloseBtn = document.getElementById('search-screen-close-btn');
  const mastheadSearchOpenBtn = document.getElementById('masthead-search-open-btn');
  const nav = document.getElementsByClassName('js__nav')[0];

  function lockSearchFocus() {
    searchCloseBtn.focus();
    document.addEventListener('focusin', focusSearchCloseBtn);
  }

  function focusSearchCloseBtn(event) {
    if (!event.target.closest('#search-screen')) {
      searchCloseBtn.focus();
    }
  }

  function unlockSearchFocus() {
    document.removeEventListener('focusin', focusSearchCloseBtn);
    mastheadSearchOpenBtn.focus();
  }

  const toggleSearchScreen = (event) => {
    // Toggle search screen visibility
    search.classList.toggle('search-screen--is-open');

    if (search.classList.contains('search-screen--is-open')) {
      if (window.DEVICE_VIEW === 'desktop') {
        lockSearchFocus();
      }
      window.TMZ.utils.setAccessibilityFocusTrap('search-screen');
      search.style.visibility = 'visible';
      setTimeout(function() {
        nav.style.visibility = 'hidden';
      }, 300);
    } else {
      window.TMZ.utils.removeAccessibilityFocusTrap();
      if (window.DEVICE_VIEW === 'desktop') {
        unlockSearchFocus();
        mastheadSearchOpenBtn.focus();
      }
      setTimeout(function() {
        search.style.visibility = 'hidden';
      }, 300);
    }

    // Hide nav
    if (nav.classList.contains('nav--is-open')) {
      setTimeout(function () {
        nav.classList.remove('nav--is-open');
      }, 300);
    }
    event.preventDefault();
  };

  // close X used to dismiss mobile search overlay
  document.querySelectorAll('.js__btn--search-toggle').forEach(searchBtn => {
    searchBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleSearchScreen);
  });
});
</script>

Austin's also had bylines in the Boston Globe, Houston Chronicle, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Fort Worth Star-Telegram and South Florida Sun Sentinel. Web Producers Mark McGreal Mark is a Producer who joined TMZ as part of the research team in 2023. He grew up just north of San Diego, and his work has been featured in the Daily Mail and a number of local California newspapers. He graduated from UCLA in 2021. Chad Lindskog   Chad is a Producer who joined the TMZ team in 2026 after spending more than a decade working for local newspapers as a sportswriter and editor, primarily covering college sports. Chad is a native Buckeye and graduated from the E.W. Scripps School of Journalism at Ohio University. Sam Howell  Sam is a Producer for TMZ.com. Sam joined the team in 2026. Sam is an East Coast transplant and has a Bachelor's Degree in Journalism. Senior Web Editors Christopher Jackson Chris is a Senior Web Editor for TMZ. Chris joined TMZ in 2019 as a logger and soon joined the news desk as an editor, where he’s been ever since. Chris has a BA in Studio Arts with a Multimedia emphasis from Loyola Marymount University. In his free time, Chris’ hobbies include creating music, programming and gaming with friends. Zoe Sherman Zoë joined TMZ as a Senior Web Producer in December 2025. Previously, she led the research team at BuzzFeed Inc. and has since worked as a freelance writer, producer, and researcher for various media outlets. She holds a Bachelor’s degree from Portland State University and a Master’s degree from the University of British Columbia. Web Editors Eva Ortega Eva Ortega is a Web Editor for TMZ.com. She joined TMZ in 2025 and holds a B.A. in Bilingual Journalism with a minor in International Relations from San Francisco State University. Eva is an L.A. native and enjoys trying new restaurants, watching horror movies and going to the beach in her free time. Creative Director Alex Rene Alex is the Creative Director of TMZ.com, where he has worked for the past 14 years. He lead the Webart Team that works on the TMZ news desk, and helps develop and maintain the TMZ brand and look. Alex has a B.A. in Graphic Design, and UX Design. Art Director James Duncan James is the Art Director of TMZ.com, where he has been a key contributor for the past eight years. Leading TMZ's Web Art Team, James collaborates closely with lead producers, writers, and editors to ensure brand consistency across all visual elements. He drives the creation of artwork for new shows, podcasts, and other TMZ products, while regularly working with teams from the News Desk, Marketing, Product Development, Podcasts, Social Media, and Graphics Departments. Drawing on his expertise in the Adobe Creative Suite, James excels at incorporating feedback, refining ideas, and delivering polished, impactful design solutions in TMZ’s fast-paced, dynamic environment. Clearance Eric Wilson Eric is a Supervising Producer overseeing the clips and clearance department across TMZ. Eric joined TMZ in 2024 from Paramount, where he was a Clearance Supervisor for various scripted television series for Paramount and CBS Studios.  Eric is a proud native Philadelphian and Billy Joel expert. Roger Corral Roger is a Senior Clearance Producer for TMZ.com. Originally from El Paso, TX, Roger joined TMZ in 2016. Roger holds a Bachelor of Journalism from The University of Texas, and a Juris Doctor from Syracuse University. Drew Shipley Drew is a Clearance Producer for TMZ.com . Drew joined the team in 2019 as an Intern for TMZ’s sister site – TooFab.com. Drew has supported the site across many departments, previously operating as Researcher and Coordinating Producer. Dylan Berry Dylan is a Clearance Producer for TMZ.com. Dylan joined TMZ in 2019 as a Tour Guide for TMZ's Celebrity Tour in Hollywood before transitioning into a Producer role on the Clearance team. Senior Photo Producer Eric Sinsley Eric Sinsley is a Senior Photo Producer for TMZ.com. Eric joined the TMZ staff in 2022. Eric holds a Bachelor of Journalism from Georgia State University. He previously worked at NBC and ABC. Photo Producer Jessica Truong Jessica Truong is a Photo Producer for TMZ.com. Jessica joined the TMZ staff in 2022. Jessica got her degree in Marketing and Information Systems from California State University Long beach. Jessica is a big foodie and enjoys going to live music events. Senior Court Producer Prescilla Phan Priscilla is a Senior Court Producer for TMZ.com. Priscilla joined TMZ in 2007 as a Court PA and has worked on the court staff ever since. Priscilla holds a MA in Broadcast Journalism from the USC Annenberg School of Journalism. Research Senior Producer Liam Connaughton Liam joined TMZ in 2021, not long after graduating from Columbia College Hollywood with a BFA in Film & Television Studies. He's a born-and-raised L.A. native, and when not working with the TMZ team, Liam's writing and directing his own passion projects, and taking them on the film festival circuit. Research Producer Sophia Lesseos Sophia joined TMZ as a Research Producer in 2026. A Los Angeles native, she has worked across television, radio, and print, including at KABC, NBC Right Now in Washington, FOX26 in Fresno, and KHTS Radio. She studied journalism at College of the Canyons and California State University, Northridge. Sophia is passionate about true crime, investigative reporting, and the kinds of stories most people would cringe at. Research Associate Producers Lindsey Acquistapace Lindsey is an Associate Producer on the Research Team. She graduated from Santa Clara University with a degree in Communication and Creative Writing. She started working at TMZ in 2025 after working in the Comedy Development Department at FOX. She is a lifelong fan of TMZ and a pop culture addict. Shenelle Charlot Shenelle is a Research Associate Producer for TMZ.com, having joined the team in May 2026. Born and raised in Lafayette, Louisiana, Shenelle holds a BA in Communications and Media Studies from Notre Dame de Namur University. She has worked in radio promotions for Meruelo Media and as an Associate Producer at Spectrum News 1.
